Moving average technique is used to smooth the data and identify the underlying price trend. Moving averages are among the easiest-to-use tools available to market technicians. A simple moving average is calculated by adding the closing prices of a stock over a specified number of time periods, usually days or weeks.
ING holds Low or High volatility?
ING Groep N.V. (ING) has ATR reading of 0.25. A stock’s Average True Range (ATR) is the difference between the high and low price on any given day. It reveals information about how volatile a stock is. Large ranges indicate high volatility and small ranges indicate low volatility. The range is measured the same way for options and commodities – high minus low – as they are for stocks.
